summary: Google Cloud CLI checks, installation, updates, and browser-based authentication.

commons.summary: Google Cloud CLI common helpers for CLI availability, version output, active account detection, auth status, and config diagnostics.

auth.summary: Google Cloud CLI browser authentication command implementation.

check.summary: Google Cloud CLI readiness command implementation.

install.summary: Google Cloud CLI installation command implementation.

update.summary: Google Cloud CLI update command implementation.

auth.summary: Starts browser-based Google Cloud CLI authentication and validates active account state.

options.--dry-run: Print the browser auth command without executing it.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: Google Cloud CLI is missing outside dry-run.
The user does not complete browser validation.
Google Cloud CLI still reports no active account after login.

check.summary: Checks Google Cloud CLI availability and active authentication status.

options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--verbose: Print gcloud configuration details when available.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: Google Cloud CLI has no active account.

install.summary: Installs Google Cloud CLI with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected install command path without executing it, even if Google Cloud CLI is already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Configures Google's apt repository and installs google-cloud-cli through apt.

expected_failure_when: The host operating system is unsupported.
The package manager or required command is missing.
The user declines the install prompt.

update.summary: Updates Google Cloud CLI with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected update command path without executing it, even if Google Cloud CLI is not installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: The host operating system is unsupported.
The package manager or required command is missing.
Google Cloud CLI is missing outside dry-run.
The user declines the update prompt.

notes: check is host-read-only and does not install, update, or authenticate Google Cloud CLI.
auth mutates Google Cloud CLI credential state and requires the user to complete browser validation.
install and update mutate the host and prompt unless --yes is provided.
install, update, and auth support --dry-run where command paths are printed but not executed.
dry-run must not short-circuit just because Google Cloud CLI is already installed or currently missing.
No run command is currently defined because Google Cloud CLI does not expose a durable local app process for this skill.
